environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the Kafka HTTP bridge consumer with default seccomp profile (runtime/default). Pod has network access to backend-service on port 8080 over a persistent TCP connection. Kafka topic 'http-requests' is writable by any authenticated producer in the cluster. Backend service is a shared HTTP/1.1 server handling requests for multiple tenants on the same connection.

config.kafka_acl: authenticated producers can write to http-requests topic
